m: सं-चाकु m. (said to be fr. √ 2. चि; but cf. सं-चक्षस्) a Ṛṣi, L.
सं-चाली f. the seed of Abrus Precatorius, L.
a: संचाली — The Guñjā shrub.

m: सं-चाल m. (of unknown meaning), BrahmaP.
सं-˚चालक m. a guide (perhaps w.r. for ˚चारक), L.
सं-चार m. (ifc. f(आ). ) walking about, wandering, roaming, driving or riding, any motion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
transit, passage, ib.
the passage or entrance of the sun into a new sign, MW.
passing over, transition, transference to (comp.), Yājñ.
transmission (of disease), contagion, W.
course, path, way (also fig. = ‘mode, manner’), MBh.; Hariv.
track (of wild animals), Śak., Sch.
course of life, career, Sāh.
a partic. class of spies, L.
difficult progress, difficulty, distress, W.
leading, guiding, ib.
inciting, impelling, ib.
a gem supposed to be in the head of a serpent, ib.
= हुं-कार, ChUp.
[w.r. for सं-चर, सं-सार, and सच्-चार]
a: संचारः — 1 Going, movement, travelling or roaming through; स पुनः पार्थसंचारं संचरत्यवनीपतिः K. P. 10; सुलभपुरुषसंचारेऽस्मिन्प्रदेशे Mk. 7; R. 2. 15. --2 Passing through, passage, transit. --3 A course, way, road, pass. --4 A difficult progress or journey. --5 Difficulty, distress. --6 Inciting. --7 Leading, guiding. --8 Transmission, contagion. --9 A gem said to be found in the hood of serpents. --10 The entrance of the sun into a new sign.

m: सं-˚चारणी (ई), f. (with Buddhists) N. of one of the 6 goddesses of magic, Dharmas. 13.
सं-˚चारणीय mfn. to be walked or wandered through or circumambulated, Bālar.
to be transmitted or transferred to (loc.), Sāh.
सं-˚चारण n. bringing near, conveying, mixing, adding, transmission, insertion, Kāv.; Sāh.
delivering (a message), Jātakam.
a: संचारणं — Moving, impelling, conveying, leading &c.

m: सं-चार—जीविन् m. (prob.) a tramp, vagabond, L.
सं-˚चारक m. a leader, guide, Hit.
N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh.
a: संचारक — a. Conveying, transmitting. --कः 1 A leader, guide. --2 An instigator. --3 An orator.

m: सं-चार—पूत mfn. purified by the course or passage (of anything), MW.
सं-चार—पथ m. a walk, walking-place, Hariv.
(in dram.) a female attendant on a king (= यवनी), Bhar.
सं-चार—व्याधि m. a partic. (prob. infectious) disease, L.
सं-˚चारयितृ m. (and ˚त्री f. fr. Caus.) a leader, guide, MaitrUp., Sch.
सं-˚चारयित्री f., a leader, guide
संचारि for सं-चारिन् in comp.
संचारि—भाव m. a transitory feeling (= व्यभि-चारि-भ्˚, q.v.), MW.
सं-चारिंस्त्व n. transitoriness, inconstancy (of feeling), Sāh.
सं-चारिणी (इणी), f. a kind of Mimosa (= हंस-पदि), L.
संचारि—चुण्डिका f. an easily propagated cutaneous eruption, smallpox, Gal.
सं-˚चारिका (इका), f. a procuress, go-between, L.
a female servant to whom is entrusted the principal care (of money matters &c.), L.
the nose, L.
a: संचारिका — 1 A female messenger, go-between. --2 A bawd, procuress. --3 A pair, couple. --4 Smell, odour.

m: सं-चारिन् mfn. going together or about, going hither and thither, roaming, wandering, moving in (loc. or comp.), Kāv.; Rājat.; Kathās.; Inscr.
going or passing from one to another, transmitted, infectious, contagious, hereditary (as a disease), Yājñ.; Rājat.
ascending and descending (applied to a note or tone), Saṃgīt.
penetrating into (comp.), Mcar.
coming together, meeting, in contact with, adjacent or contiguous to (instr.), Kād.
taken or carried together with one (as an umbrella &c.), Rājat.
carrying with one (comp.), Kām.
being in (comp.), Suśr.; Mṛcch.
engaged in, occupied with (comp.), Pañcar.
passing away, transitory, adventitious, unsteady, inconstant, fickle (= व्य्-अभिचारिन्, q.v.), Śiś.; Sāh.
influencing, impelling, setting in motion, MaitrUp.
difficult, inaccessible, W.
सं-चारिन् m. incense or the smoke rising from burnt incense, L.
air, wind, L.
a: संचारिन् — a. (णी f.) 1 Moving, moveable; संचारिणी नगरदेवतेव Māl. 1; Ku. 3. 54; संचारिणी दीपाशिखेव रात्रौ R. 6. 67. --2 Roaming, wandering. --3 Changing, unsteady, fickle. --4 Difficult to be passed, inaccessible, --5 Evanescent, as a Bhāva; see below. --6 Influencing. --7 Hereditary, successively communicated (as a disease). --8 Contagious. --9 Impelling. --m. 1 Wind, air. --2 Incense. --3 A transient or evanescent feeling which serves to strengthen the prevailing sentiment; see व्यभिचारिन्.

m: संचारि—ता f. penetration into (comp.), Mcar.
सं-˚चारित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to go, set in motion, impelled, driven, guided, Kālid.; Rājat.
transmitted, communicated (as a disease), W.
सं-˚चारित m. a person who carries out the intentions of his masters, L.
a: संचारित — p. p. 1 Moved, set in motion. --2 Impelled, driven onward, incited. --3 Conveyed; see संचर्

m: संचारि—त्व n. transitoriness, inconstancy (of feeling), Sāh.
सं-चार्य mfn. to be walked upon, accessible (in अ-स्˚, q.v.)
brought about or produced by (comp.), Śaṃk.
सं-चाय्य mfn. (scil. क्रतु, a ceremony) at which the Soma is accumulated, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 130.
a: संचाय्यः — N. of a particular sacrifice.
संच्छेदः — 1 Cutting, dividing. --2 Removal, solution.

m: सं-चीवरय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to assume the coarse dress or rags of an ascetic, Anarghar. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 20).
सं-√ चूर्ण् P. -चूर्णयति, to grind to powder, comminute, pulverize, Suśr.
a: संचूर्ण् — {c10c} U. 1 To pulverize. --2 To bruise, crush; संचूर्णयामि गदया न सुयोधनोरु Ve. 1. 15.

m: सं-चूर्णन n. the act of grinding to powder, comminution, crushing or breaking to pieces, Alaṃkārat.
a: संचूर्णनं — Crushing to pieces.

m: सं-˚चूर्णित mfn. completely pulverized or comminuted, cut or broken to pieces, MBh.; Śaṃk.; Rājat.
सं-√ चूष् Pass. -चूष्यते, to be in a state of great heat, boil over, Suśr.

a: संचः — A collection of leaves for writing upon.

m: सं-चकान See सं-√ कन्.
सं-चकास् (cf. √ काश्) P. -चकास्ति, to light up, illuminate, BhP.
सं-चकित mfn. (√ चक्) greatly startled, trembling, afraid, W.

सं-√ चक्ष् Ā. -चष्टे (pf. p. चक्षाण; Ved. inf. -चक्षे and -चक्षि), to look attentively at, observe, notice, consider, survey, examine, reflect upon, RV.; AV.; R.; BhP.; to enumerate, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; to report or relate fully, MBh.; to call, name, Car.; to avoid, shun (aor. सम् अचक्षिष्ट), Vop. (cf. अव- and परि-संचक्ष्य).
सं-चक्षस् m. a priest, sage, L.

सं-√ चल् P. -चलति, to move about or to and fro, waver, oscillate, quiver, tremble, MBh.; R.; to move away, set out or depart from (abl.), Hariv.; Śak. (v.l.); to start or jump up from (a seat), R. : Caus. -चालयति, to cause to move about or to and fro, shake, agitate, Hariv.; Śak. (v.l.); to push away, remove, expel, MBh.
a: संचल् — {c1c} P. 1 To move about, move to and fro, waver, oscillate. --2 To quiver, tremble. --3 To start or jump up --4 To depart, go away.

m: सं-चल mfn. moving about, trembling, quivering
a: संचल — a. Trembling, quivering.

m: सं-चल—नाडि f. ‘moving tube’, an artery, vein, pulse, R.
सं-˚चलन n. moving about, agitation, trembling, shaking, Kāv.; Dhātup.
a: संचलनं — Agitation, trembling, shaking; अचलसंचलनाहरणोरणः Ki. 18. 8.

m: सं-√ चर् P. -चरति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 54, Sch.), to go or come together, meet, join, Gīt.; to come near, approach, appear, RV.; AV.; to go or wander about, walk about, roam, go or drive or ride in or on (instr.), AV. &c. &c.; to reach to (आ), Kum.; to go in or through, enter, traverse, pervade, AV. &c. &c.; to pass over to, pass from one to another (gen.), Pañcat.; to issue from (abl.), ŚBr.; to move, live, exist, be, ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Bhartṛ.; to practise, perform, BhP. : Caus. -चारयति, to cause to come together, make to meet, bring into contact, VS.; ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; to cause to go, set in motion, Kālid.; Hit.; to lead about, turn out (to graze), Śak.; BhP.; to cause to pass through, BhP.; to let pass, hand round, Car.
a: संचर् — {c1c} P. (but Atm. when used with the instrumental of a conveyance) 1 To move, walk, go, pass, walk about; यानैः समचरंतान्ये Bk. 8. 32; क्वचित्पथा संचरते सुराणां R. 13. 19; N. 6. 57. --2 To practise, perform. --3 To pass over, be transferred to. --4 To act, behave; Māl. 6. 2. --5 To join, meet. --6 To pass or roam through, travel over. --7 To arrive at, reach, attain. --Caus. 1 To cause to go about, lead, conduct; यूथानि संचार्य Ś. 5. 5. --2 To cause to spread, circulate. --3 To transmit, communicate, pass over, deliver over to (as a disease &c.). --4 To turn out (as cattle &c.) to graze. --5 To impel, instigate, incite.

m: सं-चर mfn. going about, moving (see दिवा-स्˚)
going or belonging together, simultaneous, VS.; ĀpŚr.
सं-चर m. (ifc. f(आ). ) passage, a way, road, path, place for walking (esp. the space assigned to each person who takes part in a rite), TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Kālid.; Kathās.
सं-चर m. a difficult passage, defile, bridge over a torrent &c., W.
(in Sāṃkhya) evolution, development, emanation, Tattvas.
the body, L.
killing, W.
a: संचरः — 1 Passage, transit from one zodiacal sign to another. --2 A way, path; यत्रौषधिप्र काशेन नक्तं दर्शितसंचराः Ku. 6. 43; R. 16. 12 --3 A narrow road, defile, difficult passage. --4 Entrance, gate. --5 The body. --6 Killing. --7 Development.

m: सं-चर—भागिन् mfn. obtaining a share with difficulty (?), Vas.
सं-˚चरण mf(ई)n. fit or suitable for going or walking upon, accessible, practicable, RV.; ŚBr.
going or coming together, meeting, converging, MW.
सं-˚चरण (अम्), n. going together or through, passage, motion, passing over from (abl.) or in (loc. or comp.) or by means of (comp.), Kāv.; Pañcat.
(with समुद्रम्) navigation, RV.
setting in motion, use, MW.
a: संचरणं — Going, motion, travelling.

m: सं-˚चरेण्य mfn. suitable for going or walking on, practicable, RV.
सं-˚चरित्र n. coupling, procuring, L.
सं-˚चरिष्णु mfn. disposed to move or ramble about, Śiś.
सं-चर्वण (√ चर्व्) the act of chewing or masticating, Rājat.
सं-चस्कारयिषु See संचिष्क्˚, col. 2.

a: संचत् — m. 1 A cheat, rogue, juggler. --2 Cheating, deceit.

m: सं-चय &c. See सं- √ 1. चि.
सं-चय m. (ifc. f(आ). ) collection, gathering, accumulation, heap, hoard, store, multitude, quantity (dat., ‘in order to have more’), Nir.; MBh. &c.
collecting the bones of a burnt body (in अस्थि-स्˚), RTL. 284; 300
a: संचयः — 1 Heaping up, gathering. --2 Hoard, heap, accumulation, stock, store; कर्तव्यः संचयो नित्यं कर्तव्यो नातिसंचयः Subhāṣ. --3 A large quantity, collection. --4 Joint; Māl. 8. 9.

m: सं-˚चयनीय mfn. to be gathered or collected, MW.
सं-˚चयन n. the act of piling or heaping together, heaping up, gathering, collecting (esp. the ashes or bones of a body lately burnt See अस्थि-स्˚), GṛŚrS.; Mn. &c.
a: संचयनं — 1 Gathering, collecting. --2 Collecting the ashes and bones of a body after it has been burnt.

m: सं-चय—वत् mfn. possessed of wealth, rich, opulent, MBh.
सं-˚चयिक mfn. having provisions (in अ- and मास-संच्˚ qq.vv.)
सं-˚चयिन् mfn. who or what collects, W.
possessed of riches, MBh.
a: संचयिन् — a. Collecting, gathering, hoarding &c.

m: सं-˚च˚यि—त्व n. the being heaped up, Suśr.
सं-चेय mfn. to be gathered or collected or accumulated, R. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 5, 130, Sch.)
सं-√ चेष्ट् Ā. -चेष्टते, to move about restlessly, be disturbed, MBh.; to exert one's self, strive, act, ib.
सं-√ चृत् P. -चृतति, to be joined with (instr.), AV. iii, 31, 1.
सं-चृत् f. junction, union, RV. ix, 84, 2.
सं-√ 1. चि P. Ā. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, to heap together, pile up, heap up, ŚBr.; ŚrS.; to arrange, put in order, ib.; Bhaṭṭ.; to accumulate, gather together, collect, acquire, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं-√ 2. चि (only in ind.p. -चित्य, perhaps w.r. for -चिन्त्य), to reflect, ponder, Rājat.
a: संचि — {c5c} U. 1 To gather, collect, hoard; रक्षायोगादयमपि तपः प्रत्यहं संचिनोति Ś. 2. 14; R. 19. 2; Ms. 6. 15. --2 To arrange, put in order, put or place; Bk. 3. 35.
संचिंत् — {c10c} U. 1 To think, consider, reflect, think over; Y. 1. 360; Ch. P. 32. --2 To weigh (in the mind), discriminate. --3 To design, intend.
संचिंतनं — Consideration, reflection.
संचिंतित — a. 1 Considered, thought about. --2 Designed, intended. --3 Settled.

m: सं-चिकीर्षु mfn. (fr. Desid. of सं- √ 1. कृ) wishing to do or perform, Kull. on Mn. v, 86.
सं-चिक्षिप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid. of सं-√ क्षिप्) wishing to give a short description, VarBṛS.
सं-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति (ind.p. -चिन्त्य, or -चिन्तयित्वा), to think about, think over, consider carefully, reflect about (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to design, intend, destine, BhP.
सं-˚चिन्तन n. careful consideration or reflection, anxiety, Bhpr.
सं-˚चिन्तित mfn. carefully considered or thought about, deliberated, weighed (-वत् mfn. ‘one who has carefully considered’ or ‘he has carefully considered’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
designed, appointed, BhP.
सं-˚चिन्तित—वत् mfn., ‘one who has carefully considered’ or ‘he has carefully considered’
1. सं-चिन्त्य ind. intentionally, Divyāv.
2. सं-चिन्त्य mfn. to be thought over or considered, Yājñ.; MBh.
to be regarded as (वत् ifc.), R. (cf. दुः-संच्˚).
सं-चिन्वानक mfn. (fr. -चिन्वान, pr. p. Ā. of सं- √ 1. चि) occupied with the accumulation of wealth or treasures, MBh.

सं-√ 4. चित् (only pf. p. P. -चिकित्वस्, and 3. pl. pf. Ā. -चिकित्रे and -चिकित्रिरे), to observe together, survey, notice, RV.; to agree together, be unanimous, ib. : Caus. -चेतयति (pr. p. -चेतयमान), to observe, be aware of, perceive, MW.
सं-चित mfn. piled together, heaped up, gathered, collected, accumulated, ŚBr. &c. &c.
dense, thick (as a wood), R.
fitted or provided with, full of (comp.), MBh.
impeded, obstructed, VarBṛS.
frequently practised or exhibited, MBh.
a: संचित — p. p. 1 Heaped up, accumulated, hoarded, collected. --2 Laid by, stored. --3 Enumerated, reckoned. --4 Full of, furnished or provided with. --5 Impeded, obstructed. --6 Dense, thick (as a wood).

m: सं-चित—कर्मन् n. the rites to be performed after arranging the sacrificial fire, ŚrS.
सं-˚चिति f. N. of the 9th book of the Śatapatha-brāhmaṇa
heaping together, collecting, saving, Kāv.
a: संचितिः — f. A collection.

m: सं-चित्रा f. Salvinia Cucullata, L.
सं-चिष्कारयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus. of सं-√ स्कृ) wishing any one (acc.) to perform a purificatory rite, MBh. xv, 706 (B. सं-चस्क्˚).
सं-चोदक m. ‘impeller’, N. of a Devaputra, Lalit.
सं-˚चोदना f. a stimulant, MBh.
सं-˚चोदन m. (or f(आ). ) urging, exciting, inflaming, arousing, MBh.; Jātakam.
सं-˚चोदयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be urged on or impelled, Hariv.
सं-˚चोदित mfn. (fr. id.) impelled, ordered, commanded, BhP.

सं-√ चुद् Caus. -चोदयति, to impel, push on, drive, shoot off, MBh.; R.; to inflame, arouse, animate, instigate, further, ib.; BhP.; to brandish, wield, MBh.; to summon, challenge, ib.; to procure quickly, assist to obtain, RV.
सं-√ च्यु Caus. -च्यावयति, to cause to fall off, strike off, remove, MBh.
